Your questions

Before you start packing,
the right answers.

Question of the moment

How far ahead should I book?

Ideally one to two months ahead, and earlier between May and September, at month-end and during school holidays, the busiest periods. If it is urgent, call us: we review every request.

Get my free quote

The price mainly depends on volume, distance, access (floors, lift, parking) and the package you choose. The quote is free and without obligation.

Get my free quote

Share your floor area, number of rooms and main furniture items. Select “I don’t know” in the quote form if needed. CODEM will assess the volume with you.

Calculate my volume room by room

Often yes, in town. You apply to the local council, usually several weeks before the move. Your adviser explains the process for your addresses.

Request a callback

It is the document where you state the total value of your belongings and list valuable items. It sets the maximum compensation in case of damage. Your adviser helps you complete it.

Protect valuable items

Your belongings travel with other customers’ on the same route. It is often cheaper, with more flexible dates. Your adviser confirms whether it is possible.

Moving abroad

Yes. The adviser can assess your volume and access during a home visit or a video call, whichever suits you.
